preset.text:
Roundabout is a trick-taking game for 3-4 players. Red bikes are trump!

Each round you get 9 cards and must bid how many tricks you'll win. Bids wrap around +4, so bidding 3 also covers winning 7!

Bid cards: Bid 1-4 are exact bids (hard). Bid 1-2, 2-3, 3-4 are range bids (soft). Each unique bid can only be used twice.

So for example, if the first two players make a hard bid of 2, subsequent player cannot make any bids involving the number 2 (2, 1-2, 2-3).

The trick winner picks ONE card from the other played cards to keep!

Scoring:
4pts if you hit your hard bid
2pts if you hit your soft bid
-N points for missing your bid by N tricks

Most points wins!
